This project explores how cumulative savings evolve over a person’s working life using realistic assumptions and national data. It reimagines the original DollarsAndSense.sg infographic by improving clarity, transparency, and interactivity.

We used income benchmarks from MOM and savings rate estimates from SINGSTAT to model both simple and compound savings scenarios, helping users better understand long-term financial planning.

## Key Features

- Realistic benchmarking using official Singapore datasets  
- Compare linear (no interest) vs compound savings growth  
- 5-year income line for contextual understanding  
- Interactive sliders for savings and interest rates  
- Cleaner, more accurate visual representation

:::
:::::

## Tools Used

- R packages: `plotly`, `dplyr`, `tidyr`, `readxl`, `jsonlite`, `htmltools`
- Interactive dashboard built with Quarto and rendered as a website

## Objective

To promote financial literacy through accessible, data-driven visualizations that demonstrate the power of consistent savings and compound interest over time.
